lines: Statim reaches 68 decisions per second on one RTX 3070. That's 11.6 milliseconds per decision.

Statim uses a single binary and .gguf file for speed. It runs Laya checkpoints directly without Python or ORT overhead.

Statim runs any Laya checkpoint. It handles 3,880 items in S1Bench with 0.638 macro accuracy.
